verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only Microsoft Graph, a proprietary REST API. It never mentions IMAP, JMAP or SMTP access, or a standards-based export such as mbox or EML. Supporting MIME format when sending through Graph is an adjacent feature, not open-protocol mailbox access. The only export path in the evidence is a user converting .pst to mbox with the third-party readpst utility, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in
